confirmed.title: MDN Try it: while you type in the editor, focus jumps to Sift's main and the rest of the keys are lost
confirmed.evidence: With Sift on, typing 'console.log("hello sift".toUpperCase())' at 120 ms/key after a real click in the editor lost focus to sift-root>main in 5 of 5 runs. Focus left at keys 22, 25, 27, 28 and 31, so the editor kept 'console.log("hello sift")', '…".)', '…".to)', '…".toU)' or '…".toUppe)'. The rest of the keys went nowhere. Control with Sift off, same script: the editor holds the full 'console.log("hello sift".toUpperCase())' and focus stays in it. Plain letters ('let abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz = 1') did not lose focus in 2 of 2 runs. Short statements did not either ('x = "a".b', 'f(1).b'). I do not know whether this is new: works.md says a mouse edit updated the output, but not how long the edit was.

confirmed.suspectedCause: A Sift re-render while focus is inside a portaled original element (the editor) moves focus to main. Likely candidates are the new focus-keeping paths in index.ts: keepSiftFocus/main()?.focus() when portalOf(active) && !enteredPortal(), or focus restore after paint.
confirmed.verdict: Reproduced in 4 of 4 runs with Sift on, typing at 120 ms per key on the toUpperCase page after a real click in the editor. Focus moved to sift-root>main around 'toU'/'toUp'/'toUppe', and every later key was lost. In one run focus went to body first, then main. A main-world MutationObserver showed the cause. Sift's main removed 2 nodes (h2 'Try it' and figure.portal-wrap, the editor's portal), the editor fired focusout with relatedTarget null 13-46 ms later, and Sift added both nodes back 330-950 ms later. Control with Sift off kept the full 'console.log("hello sift".toUpperCase())' and focus stayed in the editor. My first three 'no repro' runs were void: the control's Alt+Shift+S had left Sift off for the site in that tab.
confirmed.fix: Sift should never drop a portal that holds focus. In index.ts, in the paint path just before setPortals/paint, if the old page's portal contains the deep active element and the new extraction lacks it, keep the old portal block in place or defer the repaint until focus leaves. Also, when focus falls to body because a portal was hidden, restore it to the original element after the portal comes back, not main()?.focus(). Separately, find why the extractor drops the 'Try it' interactive-example for a moment while the runner re-renders its output (extract/generic.ts portal detection).

confirmed.title: Long English Wikipedia articles get no Short version ('Shortening…' shows, then the full text stays)
confirmed.evidence: Bread: 'Shortening…' at 2.1 s, gone at 3.1 s, then no Short version and no 'not available' notice in the next 177 s (log /tmp/claude-1001/-home-nico/aac11194-acaf-4dad-a334-0620115b1898/scratchpad/r6t3/bread-poll.log). Bread also had none in two earlier loads (35 s, then 2.5 min). Sourdough: 'Shortening…' at 0 s, gone at 16.5 s, no Short version. Bagel: 'Shortening…' gone after 0.3 s. Rye bread: nothing in 60 s. The control cases work: es.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pan shows 'VERSIÓN CORTA' and 'Ver texto completo' at 37 s, and the short English article /wiki/Pumpernickel shows 'SHORT VERSION'. Sift's own cache (IndexedDB 'sift'/'kv', read from options.html) holds a 20,410-character Sourdough Short version written 34 min earlier ('Sourdough uses a live flour-and-water starter…'). Yet reloading /wiki/Sourdough shows no Short version and no 'Shortening…'. works.md lines 51 and 124 say Bread had a Short version that kept See also and External links. MDN Array/map also showed no Short version in 85 s, so I could not recheck works.md line 48's '6 example code blocks'.
confirmed.repro: cd /home/nico/projects/sift-test-3; SIFT_PORT=9463 SIFT_TAB=T3-tools bun scripts/act.ts goto:https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sourdough wait:500; SIFT_PORT=9463 SIFT_TAB=T3-tools bun /tmp/claude-1001/-home-nico/aac11194-acaf-4dad-a334-0620115b1898/scratchpad/r5t3/poll.ts 60 "(()=>{const t=document.querySelector('sift-root').shadowRoot.querySelector('.sift').innerText;return (t.match(/(SHORT VERSION|Show full text|Shortening…|Shortening is not available[^\n]*)/gi)||[]).join(',')})()"  (shows 'Shortening…' at most briefly, never 'SHORT VERSION'). Control: the same on https://es.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pan shows VERSIÓN CORTA.
confirmed.suspectedCause: Unknown. The cached Short version exists, so the drop happens after the model answers. Possibly the 'not much shorter' check (MAX_RATIO/MAX_WORD_RATIO) running on a cache hit against a different request text, or a content-side gate. It may also come from the slow fallback model.
confirmed.verdict: Reproduced on /wiki/Sourdough (twice) and /wiki/Bread. I tapped the AI port in the service worker. The page sends condense with 29,572 chars (Sourdough) and gets back a cached 'full' of 20,410 chars, then 'done', with no error. The page shows 'Shortening…' for about 0.3-1 s, then the full text, with no Short version and no notice. Bread behaves the same (26,402 chars in, 17,268 out). From the dumped texts: the model kept 3,119 of 4,391 prose words (0.71) and dropped all 17 [[B…]] placeholders. So the background tooLong check passes (word ratio under 0.75) and the result is cached as good. The content side's planShort then puts the 17 blocks back, and its MAX_SHOWN = 0.75 test, which counts those blocks' words, almost certainly returns null. app.tsx shortPlan then shows the full text silently, and the cache replays the same rejected answer for 30 days. I did not run planShort itself, so the exact gate is inferred, not measured. A sameArticle mismatch is unlikely on a static Wikipedia page. The root is the model writing 71% when asked for about 35%, but Sift's two gates disagree and lock the failure in. I cannot say whether it is a regression, because the earlier works.md result may have come from a different model.
confirmed.fix: Make the two gates agree. In background/index.ts doCondense, reject and do not cache an output whose prose words exceed the asked 'never more than' share (about 0.5), or retry once with a stricter prompt. Do not accept anything up to MAX_WORD_RATIO 0.75. Or, in content (app.tsx shortPlan / ai.ts), when planShort returns null on a done result, mark the job as an error so the 'not available' notice shows, and ask again with cache bypass once instead of replaying the cached text.

Results 6 and 9 both became 'Main Street is a primary road in North End, Springfield, Massachusetts, ZIP code 01115'. confirmed.verdict: Reproduced on 2 loads. Sift's result links read 'Main Street is a secondary road in Indian Orchard, Springfield, Massachusetts, ZIP code 01151', each with a 'Secondary Road'/'Primary Road' line under it that repeats the road type. The original names, kept only in the title attribute, are addresses like 'Main Street, Downtown Springfield Railroad District, Metro Center, McKnight, Springfield, Hampden County, Massachusetts, 01144, United States'. The rewrite is not shorter. It drops the district names that tell close results apart, and two results (rows 2 and 7) stay unrewritten, so the list mixes styles. In my runs the duplicate pair T3 saw did not appear, but rows differ only by neighborhood and ZIP. Cause: Out.rewriteIfLong in generic.ts marks any list whose titles average over 13 words as rewrite 'oneliner' in news mode. Comma-separated addresses pass that test, so place names are treated as headlines.
confirmed.fix: In extract/generic.ts Out.rewriteIfLong, do not rewrite titles that are names or addresses. Skip a list when most titles are comma-separated name parts (for example 3+ commas and no sentence verb or end punctuation), or when its links go to map objects (/node/, /way/, /relation/). Or set keepTitle on such items.

confirmed.title: BART Trip Planner page loses the whole planner (cross-origin iframe dropped)

Sift shows only H1 'Bay Area Rapid Transit' and the service advisory, with 0 portals, and the rest of the page is empty. So the page's only tool, trip planning, cannot be used from Sift. axe finds 0 violations. confirmed.suspectedCause: Unverified. portalBlock() in src/content/extract/generic.ts should make a portal from a large cross-origin iframe, so the iframe is probably skipped before it gets there. It is untitled, full-width, and has the class 'bart-trip-planner no-breadcrumb'.
confirmed.verdict: Reproduced. After 15 s, iframe.bart-trip-planner (src https://planner.bart.gov) is 1280x800 and visible, but Sift has 0 portals. Sift's outline ends after the Service Advisory paragraph (shot research/shots/skeptic-bart.png). The original with Sift off shows the full planner: start and destination fields, Depart Now, SEARCH and the map (research/shots/skeptic-bart-orig.png). Cause found: in visitEl() (src/content/extract/generic.ts), the NOISE_TOKEN check skips only MEDIA tags (img, picture, video, audio), so it also runs on the iframe. NOISE_TOKEN in src/content/dom.ts matches '-breadcrumb' inside the class 'no-breadcrumb'. I tested NOISE_TOKEN.test('bart-trip-planner no-breadcrumb') and it returned true. So the iframe is dropped before portalBlock() runs. High severity: the page's only tool cannot be used.
confirmed.fix: In src/content/extract/generic.ts visitEl(), exempt embedded surfaces (iframe, canvas, embed, object) from the NOISE_TOKEN skip, or only apply that skip to them when they are small. Also make NOISE_TOKEN in src/content/dom.ts ignore negated classes such as 'no-breadcrumb' or 'no-share', for example with a (?<!no-) lookbehind.
